title: Secure MCP Tunnel supervisor and credential isolation
objective: Supervise the official tunnel-client with a file-referenced runtime key, loopback-only health endpoint, and a sanitized inherited environment so cotra-mcp never receives the tunnel secret.
invariants: CONTROL_PLANE_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY are absent from the tunnel process environment
The runtime key value is absent from argv and Cotra child environment
The runtime key file is outside every trusted workspace
Only the official tunnel-client is launched
Live ChatGPT E2E remains UNPROVEN until exercised with a real tunnel

acceptance.claim: Launch plan uses control-plane.api-key=file:<path> and contains no secret value.
Secret-like environment variables are stripped before tunnel-client starts.
Trusted-workspace placement of the runtime key is rejected.
Health is configured loopback-only on an ephemeral port.
Windows and Ubuntu exact-head CI pass.

done_when: Supervisor isolation is proven on Windows/Ubuntu, PR merges, and post-merge CI is green. Live ChatGPT E2E is a separate required P03 gate.
